source.name: KCI Open API
source.credential_policy: Read only from the named environment variable. Never accept, print, persist, or commit a key.

collection.public_policy: Publish only normalized bibliographic metadata, identifiers, derived statistics, and source-backed summaries. Do not publish raw responses or full text.

request.pagination_note: Stop and report if the API repeats a page fingerprint; do not infer a different undocumented pagination mechanism.

query_groups.purpose: Find studies on Korean LLM or generative-AI writing and detection.
Find translationese, machine translation, and post-editing studies.
Narrow results to Korean-English translation and post-editing.
Find Korean stylistic phenomena with diagnostic or editing relevance.
Find work that separates semantic equivalence, grammatical accuracy, naturalness, and fluency.

include_if: The study defines, measures, or evaluates a Korean stylistic, translation, or post-editing phenomenon.
The abstract supplies enough metadata to determine language, direction, genre, method, and claimed scope.
exclude_if: The record discusses AI or translation only as a general topic without a Korean-text finding.
The claim cannot be tied to a paper, data, method, or stated limitation.
